description_good_justification: README.md opens with a one-line description: 'C2PA manifest embedding and hard binding for WebVTT subtitle and caption files' and an Overview section explaining what it embeds/extracts/validates.
interact_justification: README.md 'Quick Start' gives install commands for crates.io/npm/pip; GitHub Issues (hasIssuesEnabled=true per `gh repo view`) is the feedback channel; CONTRIBUTING.md at repo root explains how to contribute.
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md describes the PR workflow: fork, branch from main, add tests, run cargo test/clippy/fmt, open a PR (section 'Submitting Changes').
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md 'Submitting Changes' and 'Commit Style' sections specify concrete acceptance requirements: `cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings` must pass, `cargo fmt --all -- --check` must pass, and Conventional Commits format is required.
floss_license_justification: Cargo.toml declares `license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"`; both LICENSE-APACHE and LICENSE-MIT are present at repo root.
floss_license_osi_justification: Both MIT and Apache-2.0 are OSI-approved licenses (https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT, https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0), confirmed against LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE text in the repo, which match the standard license texts.
license_location_justification: LICENSE-APACHE and LICENSE-MIT hold the full texts (dual MIT OR Apache-2.0 per Cargo.toml); a top-level LICENSE file (identical to LICENSE-APACHE) is also present at the repository root for tooling that only recognizes that exact filename.
documentation_basics_justification: README.md (Overview, Quick Start, Hard binding, Validation bridge, Features sections) plus rustdoc module docs in src/lib.rs (published to docs.rs per the README badge) document installation and basic use.
documentation_interface_justification: Public API (embed_manifest, extract_manifest, compute_data_hash, verify_data_hash, remove_manifest, extract_manifest_source) has rustdoc comments in src/embed.rs, src/extract.rs, src/binding.rs and worked examples in README.md 'Generate'/'Verify'/'Remove' sections; #![warn(missing_docs)] in src/lib.rs enforces doc coverage on the public surface.
sites_https_justification: Repo (github.com), crates.io, docs.rs, npmjs.com, and pypi.org are all HTTPS-only; README badges link to these over https://.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues is enabled (`gh repo view` reports hasIssuesEnabled=true) at https://github.com/writerslogic/c2pa-vtt/issues, is publicly searchable, URL-addressable, and open to any GitHub account with no proprietary client required.
english_justification: All documentation (README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, rustdoc comments) is in English.
maintained_justification: Most recent commit 30cc716 is dated 2026-08-22 (`git log -1`), 4 days before this review (2026-08-26); 40 commits since the repo's first commit on 2026-05-14, with active dependency-update and security-fix commits throughout.
repo_public_justification: Repository is public: `gh repo view writerslogic/c2pa-vtt` reports isPrivate=false, visibility=PUBLIC, at https://github.com/writerslogic/c2pa-vtt.
repo_track_justification: Git (`.git/`) records author, committer, timestamp, and message for every change; `git log --format='%an <%ae>'` and `git log --oneline` confirm full change/author/time tracking.
repo_interim_justification: 40 commits exist between the first commit (2026-05-14) and the only release tag v0.2.0 (2026-08-02) and after it, not just release-boundary commits; e.g. 464cee0, a37106b, 39624cd, f52e3be are all interim commits after the v0.2.0 tag.
repo_distributed_justification: Repository uses git, a distributed version control system.
version_unique_justification: Cargo.toml declares `version = "0.2.0"`, a unique identifier for the release; git tag v0.2.0 matches it exactly (release.yml verifies tag-vs-Cargo.toml version equality before publishing).
version_semver_justification: Version 0.2.0 in Cargo.toml follows Semantic Versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).
version_tags_justification: `git tag -l` returns `v0.2.0`, matching the GitHub release at https://github.com/writerslogic/c2pa-vtt/releases/tag/v0.2.0.
release_notes_justification: The only GitHub Release (v0.2.0, id 363816045) has an auto-generated body (`gh release create --generate-notes` in .github/workflows/release.yml) that lists only 6 incidental dependency-bump PRs (#3-#8, all dependabot) merged in the date range; it does not describe the actual v0.2.0 feature work (modular embed/extract/hard-binding + c2pa-rs validation bridge, per commit d095583). No CHANGELOG.md exists in the repo despite .github/workflows/changelog.yml (git-cliff) being configured to generate one on push to main -- it has apparently never produced a commit (no 'docs: update changelog' commit in `git log`, and `gh api repos/writerslogic/c2pa-vtt/contents/CHANGELOG.md` returns 404).
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerabilities have been fixed in any release to date (no GitHub Security Advisories exist for this repo), so there is nothing that would need to be identified in release notes.
report_process_justification: GitHub Issues is the bug-reporting process; CONTRIBUTING.md 'Reporting Issues' section directs bug reports there and references issue templates (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml).
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues is used as the tracker for individual issues, e.g. issue #1 'Add doc-tests for embed, extract, and remove' and #2 'Handle malformed VTT input gracefully' (both closed, confirmed via `gh api repos/writerslogic/c2pa-vtt/issues?state=all`).
report_responses_justification: No qualifying reports exist to assess a majority against (evidence: Both non-PR issues filed to date (#1, #2) are closed, i.e. acknowledged and resolved, per `gh api repos/writerslogic/c2pa-vtt/issues?state=all`.). Marked unknown rather than asserting a vacuous Met.
enhancement_responses_justification: No qualifying enhancement requests exist to assess a majority against (evidence: Issue #2 'Handle malformed VTT input gracefully' functions as an enhancement/robustness request and was closed; the small number of non-dependency issues filed (2 total) have both been addressed.). Marked unknown rather than asserting a vacuous Met.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues at https://github.com/writerslogic/c2pa-vtt/issues is a public, searchable archive of all reports and responses.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md 'Reporting a Vulnerability' section is published in the repo and linked from README.md's 'Security' section, directing reporters to GitHub Security Advisories or admin@writerslogic.com.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md explains two private channels: a GitHub Security Advisory (https://github.com/writerslogic/c2pa-vtt/security/advisories/new) or email to admin@writerslogic.com.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports have been received (no GitHub Security Advisories exist for this repo as of 2026-08-26), so there is no response-time history to evaluate.
build_justification: Rust crate built with cargo check/build (.github/workflows/ci.yml "cargo check --all-features" job).
build_common_tools_justification: Cargo, the standard Rust build tool, is used (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock); CONTRIBUTING.md documents `cargo build` and `cargo test`.
build_floss_tools_justification: Cargo and rustc (used in CI via dtolnay/rust-toolchain in .github/workflows/ci.yml) are FLOSS; wasm-pack and maturin (release.yml) used for the npm/PyPI builds are also FLOSS.
test_justification: tests/e2e.rs and tests/bridge_c2pa.rs plus inline unit tests in src/*.rs form a FLOSS (Rust, MIT/Apache-2.0) automated test suite; running it is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md ('cargo test --all-features') and .github/workflows/ci.yml.
test_invocation_justification: Tests run with the standard Rust invocation cargo test --all-features, documented in .github/workflows/ci.yml and release.yml.
test_most_justification: tests/e2e.rs (106 lines) and tests/bridge_c2pa.rs (107 lines) plus inline unit tests in src/embed.rs (9), src/extract.rs (12), src/binding.rs (5), src/bridge.rs (3), src/error.rs (3) cover embed/extract/hard-binding/validation-bridge logic across the default and c2pa feature flags. Gap disclosed: src/python.rs and src/wasm.rs (the PyO3/wasm-bindgen FFI wrapper layers, each `grep -c '#\[test\]'` = 0) have no dedicated tests of their own; only the underlying Rust functions they wrap are tested.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: .github/workflows/ci.yml 'test' job runs `cargo test --all-features` on every push to main and every pull request.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md 'Submitting Changes' step 2 states: 'Make changes, add tests, run `cargo test --all-features`.'
tests_are_added_justification: Commit d095583 'feat: v0.2.0 -- modular embed/extract/hard-binding + c2pa-rs validation bridge, e2e tests' added tests/bridge_c2pa.rs and tests/e2e.rs alongside the new functionality; commit 893096a 'fix(test): follow the c2pa-rs 0.89.3 ValidationResults API change' updated tests/bridge_c2pa.rs when the dependency's API changed.
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md 'Submitting Changes' explicitly instructs contributors to add tests as part of the PR process.
warnings_justification: .github/workflows/ci.yml 'check' job runs `cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all -- --check` on every push/PR; release.yml 'verify' job additionally runs clippy across `--all-targets`, `--target wasm32-unknown-unknown`, and `--features python`.
warnings_fixed_justification: `-D warnings` in both ci.yml and release.yml turns any clippy warning into a build failure, so merges to main and releases cannot land with unfixed warnings.
warnings_strict_justification: Cargo.toml has no `[lints]` or `[lints.clippy]` table (`grep -n -A20 '\[lints' Cargo.toml` returns nothing); CI promotes only the default clippy lint set to errors via `-D warnings`, not `clippy::pedantic`/`clippy::nursery` or other stricter lint groups.
know_secure_design_justification: Evidence of secure-design awareness: SECURITY.md 'Supply-chain security' section (pinned Action SHAs, Scorecard, Dependabot, build provenance); src/lib.rs:52 `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`; README.md 'Hard binding' section documents the byte-exact exclusion-range tamper model and explicitly discusses failure modes (re-encoding fragility, why no Unicode normalization is applied to avoid false-negative tamper detection).
know_common_errors_justification: Security-focused commit history: a37106b 'fix(security): bump pyo3 to 0.29', 464cee0 'ci(security): pin actions by SHA and drop GITHUB_TOKEN to read', 18493fb 'fix(security): autofix 3rd party Github Actions should be pinned' (addressing supply-chain injection risk); src/lib.rs:52 `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` forecloses an entire class of memory-safety errors.
crypto_published_justification: Default `hash` feature uses SHA-256 via the `sha2` crate (Cargo.toml); optional `c2pa` feature delegates COSE signature validation to the c2pa crate (spec.c2pa.org). Both are publicly published, standard algorithms/protocols.
crypto_call_justification: Cargo.toml dependencies show `sha2` (dedicated hashing crate) and optional `c2pa` (dedicated C2PA/COSE crate) are called rather than any crypto being reimplemented in this crate's own source.
crypto_floss_justification: `sha2` and `c2pa` are both FLOSS crates published on crates.io.
crypto_keylength_justification: This crate generates or selects no cryptographic keys itself; it computes a SHA-256 digest (not a key) for data-hash integrity, and delegates signing-key handling entirely to c2pa-rs via the optional `c2pa` feature (src/bridge.rs).
crypto_working_justification: Default hash algorithm is SHA-256 (src/binding.rs, HashAlg via sha2), not MD4/MD5/single-DES/RC4/Dual_EC_DRBG.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Default is SHA-256, avoiding SHA-1 and other algorithms with known serious weaknesses.
crypto_pfs_justification: This crate performs no network key-agreement protocol; it is an offline file-format embedding/hashing library.
crypto_password_storage_justification: This crate has no concept of user accounts or password storage; it is a WebVTT manifest-embedding library.
crypto_random_justification: No key or nonce generation occurs in this crate's source: `grep -rn 'rand|getrandom|OsRng' src/ Cargo.toml` returns no matches. Any signing-key/nonce generation is c2pa-rs's responsibility, outside this crate.
delivery_mitm_justification: Packages are delivered via crates.io, npmjs.com, and pypi.org, all HTTPS-only registries; release.yml publishes over HTTPS (cargo publish, npm publish, pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish).
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash-only integrity check is retrieved over plain HTTP anywhere in the release process; all distribution channels (crates.io, npm, PyPI, GitHub Releases) are HTTPS.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Same alert (#2) was resolved promptly via dependency bump; no critical vulnerability found unaddressed.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: One Dependabot alert on record (#2, GHSA-chgr-c6px-7xpp, pyo3 missing Sync bound) is state=fixed; no medium+ vuln has remained open >60 days (gh api repos/writerslogic/c2pa-vtt/dependabot/alerts).
no_leaked_credentials_justification: tests/fixtures/certs/es256.pem and es256.pub contain an ES256 keypair, but it is a test-only fixture used to sign test C2PA manifests in tests/bridge_c2pa.rs (added in commit d095583 alongside the other test fixtures), not a credential for any real service, account, or production system -- standard practice for C2PA test suites. No other credential-shaped strings (API keys, tokens, passwords) were found in a repo-wide search excluding CI secret references (CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, which are GitHub Actions secret placeholders, not literal values).
static_analysis_justification: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs `cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings` on every push/PR, and .github/workflows/release.yml 'verify' job runs clippy (--all-targets, --target wasm32-unknown-unknown, --features python) as a gate before every publish -- i.e. static analysis is applied before every release.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: Only default clippy lints are enabled (no `[lints]` table in Cargo.toml, see warnings_strict); no dedicated vulnerability-pattern static analysis tool (e.g. cargo-audit, cargo-deny, Semgrep, CodeQL source analysis) is configured. OpenSSF Scorecard (.github/workflows/scorecard.yml) and Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) cover supply-chain/dependency risk, but not source-level vulnerability-pattern static analysis.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: `-D warnings` makes clippy findings build-breaking in both ci.yml and release.yml, so they are fixed before merge/release by construction.
static_analysis_often_justification: ci.yml 'check' job (which runs clippy) triggers on every push to main and every pull request, not just periodically.
dynamic_analysis_justification: A cargo-fuzz target (fuzz/fuzz_targets/parse_untrusted.rs) drives the crate's untrusted-input parsers with libFuzzer; fuzz/README.md documents how to run it.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: src/lib.rs:52 declares `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`, so no memory-unsafe (unsafe) Rust code exists in this crate to require dynamic memory-safety tooling.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The fuzz target builds with cargo-fuzz's default dev profile, which enables debug assertions and overflow checks, so Rust's integer-overflow and bounds checks act as assertions during fuzzing.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis is performed (see dynamic_analysis), so there are no dynamic-analysis findings to fix.
